## Section 3: Shape Test (regenerated)

### Log-loss comparison

The pre-registered question (P6) is answered by the **normal-at-ENGINE-mean**
column (shape alone, same mean), not the headline normal-at-MARKET-mean.
The normal-at-market-mean column shows the effect of having the correct mean.

|     Line |     N |   LL(engine) |   LL(norm,mkt) |   LL(norm,eng) |
|----------|-------|--------------|----------------|----------------|
|      mkt |   815 |      0.71414 |        0.69315 |        0.71423 |
|    mkt-7 |   815 |      0.61328 |        0.58036 |        0.61199 |
|    mkt-3 |   815 |      0.71170 |        0.67678 |        0.70811 |
|    mkt+3 |   815 |      0.69478 |        0.66644 |        0.69262 |
|    mkt+7 |   815 |      0.60497 |        0.58689 |        0.60312 |

### Null control: shifted sims at market mean
  Mean |P(cover, shifted) - 0.5| = 0.0153
  Max = 0.0560
  300/815 within 0.01
  **DID NOT HOLD** (0.015 vs 0.01 threshold). Reason: the engine's margin
  distribution is discrete (integer scores) and asymmetric around its mean.
  With N=5,000, MC SE ~ 0.007. The systematic 0.015 is ~2 SE, reflecting
  genuine scoring discreteness, not a code error.
